hotels.title: Malaysia Beachfront Luxury in Langkawi with Three Onsite Restaurants & Ocean-View Infinity Pool
hotels.description: Set on the powdery sands of Pantai Tengah, one of Langkawi’s longest and most serene beaches, PARKROYAL Langkawi Resort is a lush retreat where the sea meets the horizon. This beachfront stay offers a quieter alternative to the island’s busier stretches, while keeping you within easy reach of lively Pantai Cenang. The standout is the adults-only infinity sky pool, perched above the treetops with sweeping views over the Strait of Malacca. Down below, the beachfront pool is made for lazy afternoon dips with the ocean as your backdrop. Dine amid the action of the open kitchen at CASSIA or Mediterranean restaurant Lancava, followed by sunset cocktails at Ocean View Lounge. Unwind at SUASANA Spa while little travellers stay busy at Jungle Camp kids’ club.

hotels.title: Malaysia Beachfront Paradise with Daily Breakfast, Free-Flow Drinks Hour & Highest Rooftop in Langkawi
hotels.description: The RIYAZ Lavanya Langkawi enjoys one of the island’s most enviable locations, right beside the prime stretch of Pantai Tengah. Here, the beach is quieter and more relaxed than nearby Pantai Cenang, yet the island’s restaurants, nightlife and attractions are only minutes away. It’s the kind of location that lets you spend the morning barefoot by the sea, then be in the heart of the action whenever you feel like a change of pace. The resort’s rooftop is the perfect place to take in Langkawi’s tropical beauty, with the rooftop jacuzzi offering a calm spot to soak above the island. Come by in the early evening, when the light softens and the views stretch across the coastline, and enjoy an hour of free-flow drinks. After time on the beach and evenings beneath the open sky, the onsite spa brings the pace down again with soothing treatments in peaceful surroundings. There’s also a gym for keeping up with your routine, but the real luxury is having everything close at hand: a prime beachfront setting, a rooftop made for lingering and Pantai Cenang’s dining and entertainment just minutes away.
